## Checklist

- [ ] Branched from `develop` and targets `develop`
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] **Every commit is signed off** (`git commit -s`) — see the DCO section of
      [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the behaviour that changed
- [ ] Documentation updated if user-facing behaviour or a setting changed
- [ ] No hardcoded organisation-specific values, hostnames, credentials, or model
      identifiers — anything deployment-specific is configurable with a sane default
- [ ] No new dependency, or a new dependency with a permissive licence and a note below
